notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list the Window Rock fair with a Sept. 2-7 date range. Current official Navajo Nation Fair information identifies the 2026 Navajo Nation Fair in Window Rock for Sept. 8-13, 2026. Preserve the handwritten date as source history and use the official site as current reference. Source: handwritten call notes, page 89; official Navajo Nation Fair website.
